data.title: Review graph service outputs
data.description: With the graph service that Fleece provides, confirm that the graph service by default (with no queries) shows the full graph of all issues (not just the next issues). The `fleece list --next` command should show all issues in the sub-graph that filters out draft, closed, complete and archived issues by providing this as a filter query to the graph service. The `fleece list --next --me` command should add the additional filter for showing all queries that are assigned to the current user, and the `fleece list --next --all` command should remove the filtering on issue status and just show all issues in a single graph.
